arStrings.szText:
Collect {icon:Event_Currency_Salvation, 1.8} Dark Ages Currency and use them to claim DOOM: The Dark Ages themed cosmetics.
{icon:bullet}Elite and Champion monsters have a chance to drop {icon:Event_Currency_Salvation, 1.8} Dark Ages Currency upon being slain. 
{icon:bullet}Lair Bosses have a chance to drop a DOOM Chest which contains Unique Items with DOOM Crucible themed transmogs.
{icon:bullet}Claim all rewards to unlock the {icon:ReliquaryDetails_BonusIcon, 2.0} Bonus reward.
